## Checklist

- [ ] I read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/nunomarques97/tollwise/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (lint, type-check, tests, secret guard).
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a test that asserts a real expected value.
- [ ] No real API key, credential or personal data was added anywhere (code, tests, fixtures, commit messages). Any fake key-shaped fixture value ends its line with `tollwise-allow-secret`.
- [ ] No new dependency, or the new dependency is explained below (free, permissively licensed, no account required).
- [ ] Documentation updated if user-facing behavior changed.

## New dependency (if any)

Name, license, and why it is needed. Leave this section out if none.
